name: @Components
designer: MUST group the palette by `family` and `categories` from `ComponentIndex`; SHOULD display `familyDisplayName` and translated category names; MUST use (family, name) as the component identity.
runtime: MUST resolve components by plugin id + family + name; family is the key for shared services and actions.

name: @Icon
designer: MUST fall back to a default icon when the icon is missing or unknown; SHOULD fetch the image via the icon endpoints (see [03](../03-component-server-api.md)); MAY use the inline icon content when the index is requested with `includeIconContent`.

name: Icon key resolution and Icon.IconType
designer: MUST treat the icon as an opaque key (never assume it is one of `IconType`); MUST support keys that only exist as custom icons on the server.

name: @Metadatas / @Metadatas.Metadata
designer: MAY read the `metadata` map for host-specific behavior; MUST ignore unknown keys.

name: ComponentMetadataEnricher SPI
designer: none (consumes the resulting keys, see `DSG-008`). MUST treat unknown metadata keys as opaque.
runtime: SHOULD keep the `ServiceLoader` discovery intact when embedding `component-runtime-manager` so the built-in keys exist.

name: @Documentation
designer: SHOULD show `documentation::value` as help text (or as `tooltip` when `documentation::tooltip` is `true`); MAY also fetch the rendered component documentation (`/documentation/component/{id}`).

name: Component metadata map (keys)
designer: MUST tolerate unknown keys; MAY use `mapper::infinite`/`mapper::optionalRow` to adapt the canvas (streaming source, optional incoming row); SHOULD refresh a fixed schema when a `watch` path changes (uses the action of the same id, see `ACT-007`/`ACT-008`).
runtime: MAY use `mapper::infinite` to select streaming execution (details in RUN catalog).

name: @Partial
designer: SHOULD NOT assume full support (nested schemas) on features marked partial.

name: @Internationalized
runtime: MUST inject a proxy for `@Internationalized` interfaces (already done by `ComponentManager`); SHOULD supply the current locale (`$lang`).

name: @Language
designer: MUST pass `lang` on action calls when it wants localized results.
runtime: SHOULD supply `$lang` when it executes actions in-process.

name: Resource bundle key conventions (Messages.properties)
designer: MUST pass the requested `language` on index/detail calls and MUST display server-translated strings as is; SHOULD fall back to `name` when `displayName` is absent.

name: @DatabaseMapping
designer: MAY (Studio-like hosts only) read `tcomp::ui::schema::mapping` / `tcomp::ui::schema::mapper` (see `DSG-008`) to map column types; other hosts MUST ignore.

name: Custom icon file conventions
designer: SHOULD request icon content as SVG when it supports it, PNG otherwise; MUST NOT fail when the icon is missing.
